name: Wonder Of The Seas
line: More Than A Hundred Heaters On Deck
lede: Royal Caribbean’s Wonder of the Seas, described at launch as the world’s biggest cruise ship, lives much of its voyage outdoors. More than a hundred Platinum Electric Marine heaters warm its restaurants, bars, pool decks and balconies.
data: Wonder of the Seas, Royal Caribbean International
Restaurants, bars, pool decks and balconies

photos.caption: An outdoor lounge deck. Photograph from Bromic’s marine presentation (2022).

beats: A floating resort where so much of the voyage happens outside: restaurants, bars, pool decks and suite balconies.
Passengers needed to stay comfortable outdoors over dinner or a drink when the weather turns cool.
More than a hundred Platinum Smart-Heat Electric Marine heaters, in AISI316 stainless steel, warm the restaurants, bars, pool decks and balconies.
